baseline.needs: at least 7 older days (more than a week old) with 100 or more stories each

method.emerging: Needs about three weeks of history. A term is flagged when it appears in at least 5 stories from at least 3 outlets in the last 7 days and at least 1.8 times as often as in the 3 weeks before. Until then the page lists the most discussed two-word phrases instead. Stage: early = only research sources, spreading = research plus tech or business, mainstream = no research mentions.
method.momentum: Stories per topic in the last 7 days compared with the average week in the 3 weeks before.
method.mood: Share of upbeat vs worried words in business headlines (word lists are published). A reading of the words, not of the market.
method.agreement: Headlines from different outlets that share most of their key words.
